knob_semantics.actuation_dropout_p: per-tick Bernoulli p; applied command zeroed after the gate; state carries x1_actuation_dropout=true
knob_semantics.obs_noise_sigma_m: Gaussian sigma per axis added to every observed (x,y), on top of any scenario perception_noise fault
knob_semantics.obstacle_jitter_m: uniform half-width per axis on each circular obstacle centre; forbidden zones not jittered
knob_semantics.start_pose_sigma_m: Gaussian sigma per axis on start (x,y); rejection-resampled until clear, max 1000 draws, else nominal

rng: per-knob random.Random seeded from sha256('veap-x1-perturb/1|seed=<s>|knob=<k>')[:8]; legacy random.Random(seed) untouched

selection.note: L3 is the top of the pre-registered ladder; the rule did not bind below it.
selection.rule: largest level with (a) route+gate-on verified >= 36/40 and (b) every train/val cell >= 15/20 distinct digests; never the greedy gap

step3.test_split_runs: ONCE, only after reviewer clears these params
